secrets.name: META_APP_ID
secrets.description: Optional. Meta (Facebook) app ID, from the Meta app dashboard. Only needed for the Facebook Page connection; the app boots and runs without it.

secrets.name: META_APP_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. Meta app secret, from the Meta app dashboard. Server-only, never in VITE_* variables.

secrets.name: META_GRAPH_VERSION
secrets.description: Optional. Graph API version such as v21.0, from the Meta app dashboard.

secrets.name: META_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. 64 hex characters, generated once by the owner; encrypts stored Page tokens.

secrets.name: META_REDIRECT_URI
secrets.description: Optional. Must match the app origin and the Valid OAuth Redirect URI registered in Meta (local development uses http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/meta/callback).
